description.value: Q Spot is a Japanese restaurant in Fort St. John serving authentic Japanese cuisine alongside a Western menu, offering around 70 varieties of sushi plus nigiri, sashimi, udon, yaki-soba, pad thai, Korean specials, and bento boxes. It is one of the few dedicated Japanese food destinations in this northern BC community, making it a notable dining stop for long-distance tourers passing through the Peace River region. Dine-in, takeout, and delivery are all available.

address.value: 10440 100 St, Fort St John, BC V1J 3Z1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Q Spot is an open Japanese restaurant in Fort St. John offering dine-in, takeout, and delivery, with a broad menu including ~70 sushi varieties and multiple vegetarian-labeled items.
